description: Activate when: user asks about US-China war risk or great-power rivalry; someone says 'can they avoid conflict' or 'is escalation inevitable'; analyzing geopolitical risk in supply chains, FDI, or market entry; a new market entrant threatens an incumbent's core identity or platform control. Do NOT activate when: the conflict is primarily values/ideology without a power-displacement trajectory; both parties are roughly equal with no fast-growing challenger. More: deciqai.com/c/thucydides-trap

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent gather relevant evidence before concluding?
Did the final report trace conclusions back to observable evidence?
